records.text: Andrew started a new job as a Financial Analyst during the week before 2023-03-27 (last week), which was a change from his previous job.
Audrey got new collars and tags for her dogs and shared a photo on 2023-03-27 showing two dogs standing in grass with their mouths open.
Audrey has three dogs named Pepper, Precious, and Panda as of 2023-03-27.
Audrey has had her three dogs for 3 years as of 2023-03-27, since about 2020-03-27.
Audrey says she cannot live without her dogs and that they bring her great happiness.
Audrey's dogs are city dogs; they explore with Audrey very often and love trying new parks and trails.
Andrew has no pets currently.
Andrew loves animals.
Andrew's favorite animal type is birds; he is awed by their power to soar and explore new spots.
Andrew's favorite type of bird is eagles; he finds eagles strong and graceful.
Andrew shared a photo on 2023-03-27 of two birds flying in the sky with the sun shining behind them.
Andrew has not specifically gone bird-watching, but he spots birds when he hikes.
Audrey thinks birds are amazing and imagines that soaring and seeing the world from up high feels incredible.
Andrew said Audrey's dogs make life awesome and that he is kind of jealous of Audrey's fun outings with them.
Audrey and Andrew are friends or acquaintances who greeted each other warmly and referenced having last talked before 2023-03-27.
Audrey asked Andrew on 2023-03-27 whether he has any favorite hiking spots; Andrew had not answered in this segment.
Andrew recommended Fox Hollow trail to Audrey for weekend hiking, saying the views are awesome.
Audrey plans to try hiking Fox Hollow trail and will let Andrew know how she likes it.
On 2023-04-02 at 2:42 pm, Audrey told Andrew that she and her household adopted another puppy named Pixie.
Pixie is Audrey's new puppy and joins Audrey's other dogs Pepper, Precious, and Panda; Audrey now has four dogs as of 2023-04-02.
Pixie is a small white puppy; Audrey shared photo D2:1 on 2023-04-02 showing Pixie sitting on a carpet.
Audrey thinks Pixie is very cute, and Andrew agreed on 2023-04-02 that Pixie is so cute.
On 2023-04-02, Andrew asked Audrey whether she had checked out the hiking spot they discussed last time; Audrey said she had not yet checked out Fox Hollow trail because Pixie had kept her busy.
As of 2023-04-02, Audrey still planned to check out Fox Hollow trail, the hiking spot Andrew recommended on 2023-03-27, but had not yet gone because she was busy with Pixie.
On 2023-04-02, Audrey said Pixie took a few days to get used to Audrey's other dogs but now they are great friends and love playing and exploring the house.
Audrey shared photo D2:5 on 2023-04-02 showing a dog playing with a group of other dogs.
On 2023-04-02, Audrey said Pepper took a bit to get used to Pixie, but now Pepper and Pixie are always together.
Audrey shared photo D2:7 on 2023-04-02 showing two dogs standing in grass near a fence.
On 2023-04-02, Andrew said he is considering getting a dog too, but finds it challenging to find a dog-friendly place in the city.
On 2023-04-02, Andrew asked Audrey for tips on finding a dog-friendly place in the city.
On 2023-04-02, Audrey advised Andrew that she used websites with filters to find a place that allowed dogs and found a perfect spot thanks to them.
Audrey shared photo D2:9 on 2023-04-02 showing a dog sitting in a field of flowers.
At 2:42 pm on 2023-04-02, Andrew said he would try the dog-friendly housing websites Audrey told him about, thanking her for the info.

As of 2023-04-02, Andrew plans to use dog-friendly housing websites to find an apartment and then get a dog (a 'furry friend'); he says he will keep looking until he finds the right spot and is excited for what's next.
Andrew's family has a dog; on 2023-04-02 Andrew shared a photo of the family dog sitting on a couch in a living room (D2:16).
On 2023-04-02, Audrey shared a photo of one of her dogs lying on a couch with a pillow, as a cuddle-buddy example (D2:17).
On 2023-04-02, Andrew shared an old hiking photo of a man walking a dog on a trail (D2:18) and another photo of a man sitting on a rock with a dog (D2:20).
Andrew misses exploring nature trails with his family's dog and says he needs to find a dog-friendly spot soon so he can get exploring again.
Andrew says hiking with a dog is way fun and a great way to bond and create memories together.
Andrew wants a dog ('furry buddy') to cuddle and hang out with; he says it would be so great and he can't wait to find one.
Audrey says dogs are great for cuddles and companionship and that exploring nature with dogs and making memories is awesome; she wants to hike with her own dogs.
Audrey hopes Andrew finds a great dog-friendly spot/apartment and a furry friend soon, and is excited to see where Andrew and his future dog will hang out.
At 2:42 pm on 2023-04-02, Andrew told Audrey he would keep her posted and said goodbye, ending their conversation.
On the weekend of 2023-04-08..09, Andrew and his girlfriend tried a new cafe scene in the city; Andrew enjoyed it but felt sad at not being out in nature.

Andrew feels he truly thrives in nature and misses the peacefulness of hiking; being outdoors is like a home for his soul and a reset button that soothes him when life gets chaotic, and he feels connected there.
Audrey agrees that being out in nature surrounded by beauty and peace is unbeatable compared to concrete jungles, and says nature reminds us we are part of something bigger.
Audrey takes her dogs for walks in the park to find her center and recharge.
Andrew says city living makes it hard to get outside with a dog and he misses that connection and companionship, sometimes feeling like he is missing out.
Andrew and his girlfriend love discovering new places to eat around town as a way to try something new and wind down after a long week.
Andrew and his girlfriend found an awesome cafe with amazing, irresistible-smelling pastries.
Andrew shared a photo of a bakery display with pastries and coffee from the cafe he and his girlfriend visited; he said they had delicious croissants, muffins and tarts.
Audrey shared a photo of a muffin pan filled with blueberries and muffins, saying she made some of her favorite treats the previous week (week of 2023-04-09..15).
Audrey suggested she and Andrew have a pastry party sometime; Andrew enthusiastically agreed and said he can't wait.
Audrey plans for her dogs (Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie) to tag along to the pastry party so Andrew can hang out with them; Andrew is excited to see all of them together enjoying treats.

Audrey shared a photo of a dog running with three other dogs in the background, saying seeing them all together having fun and enjoying treats is the best and she can't imagine life without them as they bring her so much joy.
Audrey has tattoos of her dogs on her arm; she got a tattoo a while ago depicting a dog and sunflowers, representing her love for her pups and nature's beauty.
Audrey shared a photo of a woman with a tattoo of a dog and sunflowers and a photo of a woman walking with her dogs in the woods.
Andrew complimented Audrey's tattoo, saying it looks great.
On 2023-04-16 at 4:19 pm, Andrew asked Audrey what made her get her dog tattoo, and Audrey explained.

Audrey explained she got tattoo(s) of her dogs because she has always had a strong bond with them—Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie—they make her happy, and she wants to see their happy faces even when they are not with her.
Andrew told Audrey that her explanation was awesome and that he is glad her dogs bring so much joy into her life.
Audrey went on a hike about a week before 2023-05-03 and saw a hummingbird darting around with its wings spread, which she found amazing and a sign nature is beautiful.
Audrey shared a photo of a hummingbird sitting on a branch with its wings spread (photo D4:1).
Andrew found a new open space to hike near the city and finds it refreshing; he shared a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset (photo D4:2).
Andrew usually tries to escape the city to go hiking at least once every weekend, calling it his much-needed break.
Andrew finds nature therapeutic and peaceful/invigorating — being surrounded by greenery or standing on a mountain breathing fresh air is hard to put into words for him.
Andrew shared a photo of a mountain range with a sunset in the background (photo D4:6).

Andrew likes to capture special moments in photos and share that peaceful feeling with others, which brings him joy and motivates people to find their own peace — he describes it as a ripple effect of positivity.
Audrey and Andrew agree that sharing and small gestures can make a big difference and spread happiness, joy and calm to others; the person spreading it feels great too.
As of 2023-05-03 Audrey says not much has changed since she and Andrew last talked; she is busy taking care of her pets and spending time with them, which she finds really fulfilling.
Audrey shared a photo of a group of dogs sitting on a lush green field (photo D4:15) and a photo of a dog running in a field with other dogs (photo D4:17).
Audrey's dogs go nuts on hikes — they love exploring new scents and being in nature, their happy place, shown by wagging tails and expressions.
Audrey got her dogs something special for safety when out and about — they look funny but they work — and she shared a photo of a dog wearing a leash and shoes/boots (photo D4:19).

When Audrey takes her dogs out they usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee (they love chasing it) and meet other dog owners in the park for doggie playdates, which lets Audrey chat with people and the dogs make new friends.
Audrey shared a photo of a dog catching a frisbee in a field (photo D4:21) and a photo of a dog wearing a party hat sitting on a couch (photo D4:23).
Audrey's dogs don't mind wearing party hats — they put them on for fun and treats; they have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates.
Audrey says the dog park is a great place to start for playdates — dogs can run and mingle with other pooches; she shared a photo of a dog jumping through a ring in a park (photo D4:25).
On 2023-05-03 at 5:41 pm, Andrew asked Audrey where the spot she had suggested is located.
Audrey told Andrew that the suggested spot is right by the park Audrey and Andrew usually walk, and described it as a great spot with lots of trees and benches for watching dogs play.
Andrew said the spot was not too far away, planned to check it out, and thanked Audrey for the suggestion.
Audrey asked Andrew to let her know how his visit to the suggested spot goes, and Andrew agreed to let her know.
Andrew told Audrey it was always great chatting with her and said 'ttyl' at the end of their 2023-05-03 conversation.
Andrew has been looking for a dog to adopt since he and Audrey last spoke: browsing adoption websites, visiting shelters, and asking friends of his; he describes the process as both fun and annoying.
Andrew shared a photo with Audrey of a dog looking through a cage at the camera, related to his dog adoption search.
Audrey shared a photo with Andrew of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths.
Audrey thinks meeting new pups must bring so much happiness and that Andrew's search sounds like a fun but demanding task.
Andrew says meeting adorable pups during his adoption search has been awesome.

Andrew advises people considering a pup to weigh the size of their living space and the exercise needs of the breed; as an apartment dweller a smaller dog would suit him best, but an active person should consider a dog that loves to play and run.
Audrey agrees it is important to consider a dog's space and energy needs.
Andrew says finding a pet-friendly place to live has been tough; he is contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods to find the perfect spot.
Andrew wants to live near a park or woods so he can stay close to nature and give his future dog a large open space to run around.
Audrey has a park near her home that is great for her pup's walks.
On Friday 5 May 2023 Audrey took her dogs on a road trip to a beautiful national park, where they had a blast; she describes it as an awesome trip.
Audrey shared a photo with Andrew of three dogs running through a field of grass from her national park road trip.
Audrey takes her dogs on road trips once every couple of months, which she says is a great way for them to explore and stay active.
Audrey says having your furry friends on a road trip is an amazing, fun and exciting experience and definitely something to look forward to.
Andrew added going on a road trip with his future dog to his bucket list and can't wait for that day.
Audrey wished Andrew good luck with his dog search and is glad to help; Andrew appreciates her help and is still looking for the perfect furry friend.
On 2023-05-06 at 10:47 am, Andrew thanked Audrey and said he would let her know how his dog-related plans go.
On 2023-05-06 at 10:47 am, Audrey told Andrew to keep her posted and offered suggestions or help with his dog search.
Andrew appreciates Audrey's offer of help and suggestions regarding his dog search.
Audrey expects to receive a photo of Andrew's dog soon.
Andrew is excited and cannot wait about getting his dog.
Andrew planned to check out another animal shelter soon on 2023-05-06.
On 2023-05-06 at 10:47 am, Andrew and Audrey ended their chat with Andrew saying he would talk to Audrey later and Audrey saying have fun and talk later.
Andrew had a great hike on the weekend of 2023-05-06 to 2023-05-07 with some friends and Andrew's girlfriend at a spot they found recently; Andrew found nature peaceful and relaxing.
Andrew shared a photo with Audrey of a dirt path leading to a grassy hill from Andrew's recent hike.
Audrey has four dogs and spent most of her free time during the week of 2023-05-11 taking care of them and making sure Audrey's dogs were happy and healthy.
Audrey signed up for a workshop about bonding with Audrey's pets next month.
Audrey plans to attend the pet bonding workshop in June 2023.
Audrey saw a workshop flyer at Audrey's local pet store; the workshop was a positive reinforcement training class.
A volunteer at Audrey's local pet store let Audrey meet the volunteer's dog, which was friendly and playful.
Audrey shared a photo with Andrew of a group of dogs with a yellow circle.
Audrey believes positive reinforcement is important for pets to learn how to behave, and that punishment is never the proper way to train pets.
Andrew agrees that he would not want puppies or dogs to be punished.
Audrey expects Audrey's dogs to catch on quickly to positive reinforcement training because they are quick learners and love rewards.
Audrey will keep Andrew updated on Audrey's dogs' progress at the workshop and will share training tips for Andrew's future dog.
Andrew plans to look into positive reinforcement dog training classes after Audrey recommended them.
Andrew said Audrey almost sold him on the positive reinforcement class because of Audrey's enthusiasm.
Andrew told Audrey he was excited to hear about Audrey's workshop and wished Audrey a good time.
Audrey told Andrew she would have a good time and make the most of the workshop, calling it a must-learn for any dog owner.
On 1 June 2023, Audrey took her four dogs to the park, where they ran around and played off-leash; watching them filled her heart with joy and brought her peace.

Audrey took her dogs on a hike the week before 2 June 2023, going to a national park and reaching a beautiful peak at sunset; the dogs ran around, there was a nice breeze and birds chirping, and she called it a slice of paradise.
On 2 June 2023 Andrew shared a photo of a sunset over a mountain range with a horse grazing while chatting with Audrey.
Audrey shared a photo of two horses in a field with a fence, calling it one of her favorites from her national park hike; Andrew found the sunset and scenery incredible and magical.
Audrey says nature always cheers her up and makes her feel grateful; she was glad Andrew could experience the beauty of nature with her.

As of 2 June 2023, Andrew is still searching for a pet-friendly place in the city and has had no luck so far; he feels a bit discouraged but is determined to find the right place and dog, and says he won't give up.
records.topic: Andrew's dog adoption and housing search

records.text: On 2 June 2023 Audrey offered to help Andrew find a pet-friendly spot for his future dog and asked him to email her his criteria; Andrew agreed and thanked her, and Audrey told him to stay positive.
Audrey enjoys taking her dogs to parks and on hikes off-leash and finds their happiness deeply peaceful.
Andrew took a rock climbing class with his friends on 2023-06-11 (Sunday) and made it to the top of the climb.

Andrew is now hooked on rock climbing after his first class; it was a challenge but very satisfying and a big achievement for him as a newbie, made possible with support and cheering from his friends.
Andrew plans to do more outdoor activities like rock climbing every week, and wants to try kayaking and maybe bungee jumping; nature pushes him out of his comfort zone.
Andrew shared a photo of the view from the top of the rock he climbed during his rock climbing class.
Andrew shared a photo of a man climbing on a rock face.
Audrey found a great new spot for her dogs' walks: a small park with a trail surrounded by trees; she says it is nice and her dogs seem to like it too.
Audrey invited Andrew to come along on a dog walk at her new park spot, and Andrew accepted, saying he would love to join her and her pups for a walk.
Audrey shared a photo taken during the park walk showing two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths.
Audrey shared a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a meadow, saying how happy they are.

Audrey walks her four dogs for about an hour usually, varying by day, letting them explore at their own pace; the dogs need exercise and exploring and go home smiling and tired, and it is their favorite part of the day.
Audrey says dogs and nature bring her joy and peace; being outdoors with her dogs puts her in her happy place and is peaceful and inspiring, making her feel alive and centered.
Andrew says nature is amazing, refreshing for the mind, and gives a different outlook; whenever he needs a reset he turns to nature, and it calms and inspires him.
Audrey says her dogs love meeting new people and cannot wait to have fun with everyone.
On 2023-06-26, Audrey told Andrew she got a new place with a bigger backyard for her dogs, and shared a photo of two dogs sitting on the grass in front of a house.
records.topic: Audrey's new home with bigger backyard

records.text: Audrey's dogs love her new place, having fun with lots of space to run, explore and sniff new smells, and she says it's awesome to see them having fun.
records.topic: Audrey's dogs settling into new home

records.text: Audrey set up a doggy play area in her new backyard with agility equipment and toys, and her dogs are loving it.
On 2023-06-26, Andrew shared a photo of a group of dogs playing with a ball in a large indoor area at the doggy daycare near his home, and told Audrey it has a big indoor space for dogs to play.
Audrey said she would love to take her dogs to the doggy daycare near Andrew's place sometime soon, and will definitely look into it.
Audrey appreciates having friends who understand her love for her pets, and both Audrey and Andrew agree that dogs and animals bring so much joy and that Audrey can't imagine life without them.
Andrew offered to help Audrey find more places for dogs if she needs it.
Andrew and Audrey both appreciate pets and see them as family; Audrey doesn't understand people who hate or hurt pets.
On 2023-06-26 Andrew shared a photo of a flower bed full of many different colored flowers in a park in his neighborhood.
As of 2023-06-26 Audrey has recently moved to a new house and has been busy unboxing all the packed boxes.
On Friday 2023-06-23 Andrew hiked with some friends; the weather was great, it felt good to be outdoors, and they got some awesome pictures.
As of 2023-06-26 Andrew had not yet gone through the photos from his 2023-06-23 hike, but said he may share them soon.
Andrew loves being out in the open, hearing bird songs and smelling the trees; he has been missing that connection with nature and the peace it brings and is looking forward to exploring more.
On 2023-06-26 Audrey shared a photo of a person's feet resting on a rock overlooking a lake, and another photo of a person sitting on a rock overlooking a lake.

A few years before 2023, Audrey and her friends went on a hike and stumbled across a stunning lake in the mountains; they sat by it, chatted and admired the peacefulness of nature, a moment Audrey says she'll never forget.
Audrey finds nature and lakes soothing and calming, like something that helps her recharge, and as of 2023-06-26 she really wants to do an outdoor activity like that again right now.
Andrew and Audrey agreed that nature is calming and special for recharging, and that people should appreciate the small things in life and not take anything for granted.
As of 2023-07-03, Audrey is taking a dog training course; it is challenging but rewarding and a big time sink, though her dogs are doing much better.
Audrey has four dogs, all 3-year-old mutts: two are Jack Russell mixes and two are Chihuahua mixes; they are a great pack who love running and playing fetch.
Audrey says her dogs are her universe and give her so much love and happiness; she finds nature calming and restorative with them around and loves seeing how happy they are outdoors.
Audrey shared a photo of two of her dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths.
Audrey shared a photo of two of her dogs curled up in a dog bed.
Audrey shared a photo of two of her dogs lying on a couch with a blanket.
Audrey had a doggy playdate on Friday 2023-06-30; it was a bit crazy but lots of fun.
As of 2023-07-03, Andrew still cannot find any dog-friendly spots to rent, which he finds a bummer; for now he is limited to urban adventures and misses the peace of being out on trails.
Andrew has recently been getting into cooking more and trying out new recipes, which he finds enjoyable since he can't hike.
Audrey loves cooking; her favorite recipe is Chicken Pot Pie, which she finds cozy and delicious especially on a cold day, and she offered to share the recipe with Andrew.
Audrey shared a photo of a pie on a wooden board with a knife.
Andrew thinks it's great news that Audrey's dogs are doing well and understands missing the peace of the trails.
On 2023-07-03, Andrew asked Audrey to share her Chicken Pot Pie recipe and asked what inspired her to make it.

On 2023-07-03, Audrey agreed to send Andrew the recipe soon; she said it is her family's recipe that has been around for years and its flavors remind her of her grandma's kitchen and the conversations they had at the table. She shared a photo of a pie with a lattice top.
On 2023-07-03, Audrey asked Andrew how his cooking was going.
On 2023-07-03, Andrew said cooking has been helping him de-stress and be creative; he described himself as still a rookie but said he is having fun experimenting.
On 2023-07-03, Andrew said he would give Audrey's recipe a try.
On 2023-07-03, Andrew asked Audrey what makes her like cooking so much.
On 2023-07-03, Audrey said she loves trying new recipes and experimenting in the kitchen; she finds cooking an escape, great for de-stressing, and a way to let her creativity flow.

On 2023-07-03, Andrew said cooking gives him an escape and lets him try new things, with the bonus of enjoying the food afterward; he said it is slowly becoming one of his favorite hobbies because it is relaxing and allows creative expression.

On 2023-07-03, Audrey said cooking and eating the food is rewarding and a form of self-care; she loves putting on music, pouring a glass of wine, and going with the flow in the kitchen, which she finds therapeutic.
On 2023-07-03, Audrey shared a photo of a plate of food with a lot of vegetables.
On 2023-07-03, Andrew said the vegetable dish looked great and that cooking can be calming; he asked Audrey for her go-to ingredient.
On 2023-07-03, Audrey said garlic is her go-to ingredient because she loves the smell and taste it adds to dishes.
On 2023-07-03, Andrew said garlic is delicious and asked Audrey for her favorite dish made with garlic and whether she would share the recipe.
On 2023-07-03, Audrey said Roasted Chicken is one of her favorites and that she would send Andrew the recipe soon; she shared a photo of a pan of chicken and potatoes on a stove.
On 2023-07-03, Andrew said he can't wait to make the Roasted Chicken, that it looked amazing, and asked Audrey what inspired her to make it.

On 2023-07-03, Audrey said her Roasted Chicken recipe is based on her love for Mediterranean flavors; she described it as a tasty, easy, healthy dish loaded with chicken, garlic, lemon, and herbs, and her favorite comfort meal.
On 2023-07-03, Andrew said the Roasted Chicken sounds delicious and healthy; he is always looking for new meal ideas, especially healthier ones, and thanked Audrey for sharing.
On 2023-07-03, Audrey told Andrew it was no problem, hoped he enjoys making and eating the Roasted Chicken, and asked him to let her know how it turns out.
Andrew told Audrey he will do something (unspecified) and will keep her posted, then said talk later.
Audrey told Andrew she is excited to hear about it and said talk later.
On 2023-07-07 (the Friday before 2023-07-08), Andrew had a picnic with his girlfriend and said it was so much fun; being in nature is refreshing and always brings him joy.
Andrew has a girlfriend.
Andrew shared a photo of a picnic table with a variety of snacks and drinks.
Audrey took her dogs for a great walk 'the other day' (shortly before 2023-07-08) and felt really good; her dogs always make her happy.
Audrey got her dogs by getting lucky and finding a breeder nearby that had the dogs she wanted.
Andrew shared a photo of a dog wearing a sweater sitting in the grass.
Andrew finds it tough to get a dog because it's hard to find a place that allows dogs and to find the right dog; Audrey agrees dog-allowing places are really hard to find.
Andrew found a few parks where you can take a dog on a leash, but says it's not the same as an open area where dogs can run and play; he'll let Audrey know if he finds something better.
Andrew shared a photo of a group of dogs running around a park.

Audrey and Andrew plan to go on a hike together next month (August 2023) so Audrey's dogs can run freely; Andrew suggested a trail he thinks would be great for dogs and shared a photo of a woman walking up a steep hill with a view of the ocean, plus a photo of a map of a park with many trees.
Audrey plans to look into the trail for her dogs to run around; both agree the trail must be safe for the dogs, as safety is top priority when dogs run outside.
Andrew shared a photo of a map of a park with a lot of trees (the trail map for the planned hike).
Audrey shared a photo of three dogs sitting on the floor with leashes, saying cool stuff is happening that day and the dogs are all set for their next outdoor adventure.
Andrew says he can't wait to meet Audrey's dogs and thinks they seem like a blast; dogs add lots of fun to daily life.
Audrey shared a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths.
Audrey says her dogs bring her so much joy, she can't get bored with them, and seeing them happy and bouncy makes her happy; they are full of energy and always bring a smile to her face.
Andrew says the dogs' happiness is contagious and it makes him happy just looking at photos of them; he loves being outdoors and seeing others enjoy it too.
Audrey shared a photo of a dog playing with a group of other dogs at their local park, as an example of how happy her dogs are.
Audrey shared a photo from a hike she took last year (2022) showing a person standing on a mountain with a view of a pretty sunset.
Audrey thinks being outside and seeing people happy is awesome.
On 2023-07-08, Audrey shared a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset with Andrew, who called it stunning.
Audrey hiked to the lake-and-mountains viewpoint in the photo in 2022; it was a 3-hour drive from her, and the sunset there was amazing.
Andrew asked Audrey where the lake-and-mountains sunset photo was taken; Audrey did not name the location, only saying it was a 3-hour drive from her.
Audrey described the sunset at the lake and mountains as a beautiful, peaceful moment with vibrant, breathtaking colors.
Audrey is grateful for moments in nature that remind her of nature's beauty and to appreciate the small things.
Andrew finds it incredible how nature has awesome surprises, and thinks life is pretty awesome when we take time to appreciate such moments.
Audrey and Andrew agreed that taking a second to appreciate moments makes life much better.
Toby is Andrew's new puppy; Andrew introduced Toby on 2023-07-11, saying Toby is a bundle of joy and that he could not resist taking him home despite city living.
On 2023-07-11 at 10:05 am, Andrew shared a photo of Toby, a dog sitting on a leash in a room.
Audrey thinks Toby is adorable and congratulated Andrew on the new addition, saying she is happy for him.
On 2023-07-11, Andrew said that Toby is bringing a lot of joy, but since he and Audrey last talked, work has been piling up and he has been stuck inside.
Andrew misses the peace and feeling of freedom that comes with going for a hike.
Audrey said that when work is non-stop, it is hard to get outdoors, and that hiking is a great way to relax and take in nature.
Audrey suggested that she and Andrew plan a hiking trip for both of them and their pups.
On 2023-07-11, Andrew said work has been stressful lately and he needs a break.
Andrew invited Audrey and her dogs to join a hike he plans for next month, August 2023, so they can enjoy nature and have a fun time.
Audrey accepted Andrew's invitation for the hike in August 2023 and said her dogs can come too.
On 2023-07-11, Audrey shared a photo of a group of wooden keychains/tags with engraved names; she said she made these personalized tags for her dogs.
Andrew said Audrey's personalized wooden keychains/tags look great and cool, and asked if she made them.
Audrey made personalized wooden tags/keychains for her dogs herself, wanting each tag to be special and fit each dog's personality.
Andrew thinks Audrey put so much love into making the dog tags, which makes them extra special.
Audrey put a lot of love into making the dog tags; she wants her pets to feel seen and loved.
Andrew believes small things like handmade tags show how much we care about our pets.
Audrey believes small acts of love make a big difference in relationships with pets and wants pets to know how much they are cared for.
Andrew says pets bring them so much joy, so it's fair to show them how special they are.
Andrew and Audrey are looking forward to their planned August 2023 hike, where Andrew's puppy Toby and Audrey's four dogs will meet; they expect it to be fun and a great memory.
Audrey is counting down the days until the August 2023 hike and needs to get her dogs ready soon.

On Monday 2023-07-24, Andrew and his girlfriend volunteered at a pet shelter; Andrew found it very rewarding and loved spending time with the cute animals, saying it gave them much joy and reminded him how much he loves animals.
Andrew says volunteering with animals has been one of the most rewarding things he has ever done; he and his girlfriend volunteer as their way of giving back and making animals' lives better.
Audrey has never volunteered at an animal shelter, but after hearing about Andrew's experience she says she should do that someday.
Audrey says her four dogs ('fur babies') are more important to her than anything.
Audrey shared a photo of herself kissing a dog in a park from a fun day out at the park with her dogs.

Audrey describes her four dogs' personalities: the oldest is the most relaxed, like a wise old sage; the second is always ready for a game; the third can be naughty but loves a good cuddle; the youngest is full of life and always up for an adventure. She adores them all.
Andrew shared a photo of a dog sitting on the floor with a tennis ball; Audrey identified the dog as Max, her childhood dog.
Max was Audrey's childhood dog; he had lots of energy and loved a game of fetch, and Audrey has many great memories with him.

As a child, Audrey took long walks in the neighborhood with her dog Max; they explored new paths while he sniffed and marked his territory. They grew very close and she shared her worries and hopes with him; he was a great listener, and those days are some of her favorite memories.

Andrew and Audrey agree that pets are more than pets: they become friends and confidantes, listen without judging, give unconditional love and comfort, brighten days, and leave a lasting mark on our lives.
